# <span id="aanchor153"></span> Service Monitor

Use the Service Monitor to view the status and activity for services running in FLOWCAL. Current activity for the selected service displays in the scrollable window.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Service Monitor:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  Select **Service Monitor** in the **Services** group.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 481;height: 490;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Service Monitor Screen Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

#### Service Status



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 20;height: 20;" /> **Green** - The service is currently awake, running, and processing requests on the host machine. Messages are displayed on the screen.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 20;height: 20;" /> **Yellow** - The service is running but is currently idle or waiting for the next cycle.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 20;height: 20;" /> **Red** - The service is not running or a connection to the service could not be established (the service may not have been started).

#### Buttons

- **Edit Host** - If the service you are monitoring is not running on your local machine, change the host being monitored to the IP address of the machine where the service is running.

- **Connect All Services** - Click to restart the Service Monitor. This is often used in conjunction with the Edit Host function when pointing to a new host machine.

- **Connect to Port \# / Disconnect** - If there are multiple copies of the selected service running on the specified host, click the **Disconnect** button to stop monitoring the copy running on the designated port. Enter the appropriate port corresponding to the copy you want to monitor and then click the **Connect to Port \#** button to restart the Service Monitor.

  To monitor a duplicate service, add the service number to the base port number. (Example: FcSrvMtrRollups is port 5001, so FcSrvMtrRollups2 would be 5002.)

</div>
